subquestions.text_open: 9-3-2 Compound 9D is the addition product of acetonitrile and hydrogen peroxide, and 9G contains a peroxide bond. Write the SMILES representations of small molecules 9D and 9F in the catalytic cycle below.

text_images.description: The image shows a reaction segment in which the far-left compound 'C/C=C/c1ccccc1' reacts to the right under an arrow labeled “9C (15 mol%), H_2O_2 (4 equiv.)” above and “K_2CO_3, CH_3CN” and “0°C, 12h” below.

The image is a catalytic cycle. At the top is 'CC1(OC[C@]2(OC[C@H]3OC(C)(O[C@H]3C2=O)C)O1)C', labeled “9C” below. On the right, `CH_3CN + H_2O_2` points left by a straight arrow to “9D.” A curved arrow from “9D” runs down and left into the main cycle, merging with the downward path from “9C,” and both lead to “9E.” Two curved arrows descend from “9E,” one down-right to “9F” and the other down-left to “9G.” A curved arrow from “9G” runs up and left, meeting an upward curved arrow from 'C/C=C/c1ccccc1' at the lower left; together they lead to `[transition state]^‡`. Finally, a curved arrow from `[transition state]^‡` runs up and right to close the cycle at “9C,” with a curved branch along this upward path pointing up-left to the word “product.”

rubric: The SMILES representation of 9D is 'CC(OO)=N', and that of 9F is 'CC(N)=O'; 2 points each.

rubric_images.description: The rubric image gives the SMILES representation of 9D as 'CC(OO)=N' and that of 9F as 'CC(N)=O'.
